_readme: Every generation job for Scripts/gen_batch.py. Edit subjects here, not in the scripts. 3D jobs get the locked style words from Docs/styles.json via --type <group>; 2D jobs get styles_2d[group] + rules_2d[kind] + subject. Stages: test (one anchor per style group, plus the hero rig probe), batch1 (everything the must-ship scenes need), batch2 (should and stretch). A job outside 'test' runs only after its group is approved (gen_batch.py approve <group>). 2D jobs outside 'test' attach their group's approved anchor image as a style reference. Source of truth for what each asset is for: Docs/Design/ASSETS.md and Docs/GenerationMap.md.

styles_2d.2d_knight: Painted dark-fantasy video game UI art: black iron and aged leather, sharp angular edges, desaturated palette, heavy shadows, accents of blood red and dull gold, grim and pompous, crisp silhouette that reads at small size.
styles_2d.2d_fenella: Bright bold-outlined cartoon video game UI art: thick dark outlines around every shape, saturated candy colours, paper and cardboard textures, slightly scrappy handmade low-budget film-production props, simple flat shading, crisp readable shapes.

rules_2d.icon: Exactly one item, centred, filling about 80 percent of a square canvas, isolated on a fully transparent background. No text, no letters, no numbers, no border, no frame, no scenery, no cast shadow.
rules_2d.stamp: Exactly one rubber-stamp impression, centred, isolated on a fully transparent background, ink slightly uneven and grungy, tilted about 8 degrees. The words must be spelled exactly as given in quotes, in bold block capitals. No other text.
rules_2d.frame: A decorative frame or border only, centred on the canvas. The inside of the frame is completely empty and transparent, and so is everything outside it. No text, no letters.
rules_2d.portrait: Head and shoulders, centred, facing slightly toward the viewer, isolated on a fully transparent background. No text.
rules_2d.full: The artwork fills the entire canvas edge to edge. No text unless words are given in quotes, and then spelled exactly.

jobs.subject: a towering knight in scorched black plate armour with a tattered dark tabard, closed great helm with a narrow visor slit, broad pauldrons, gauntlets, no cape, empty hands
rig the hero (UE5 mannequin skeleton) and make idle, walk, strut, one-hand-up, and text-to-motion sword raise, scrub and sigh
args: SwordRaise=3:A heavy armoured knight holding a greatsword in his right hand slowly and pompously raises the sword straight up above his head with his arm fully extended, then freezes and holds that pose, chest out, feet planted.
Scrub=3:A standing knight holds a small object in his right hand at chest height in front of him and scrubs it rapidly side to side, like brushing teeth, feet planted.
Sigh=3:A standing knight lets his shoulders drop in a long heavy disappointed sigh, head tilting down and shaking slowly side to side, then straightens up.
